profile_text.body:
Alignment Research Center (ARC) is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. The organization describes its mission as aligning future machine learning systems with human interests.

ARC's research motivation centers on the challenge of alignment as AI systems advance beyond human capabilities. The organization notes that as AI progress accelerates, it may become increasingly difficult to adapt alignment techniques quickly enough to match technological change. ARC seeks to develop methods that can be safely scaled across many orders of magnitude, comparable to how generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled dramatically over the past decade.
